behavior: Walks and wades along wet ground and shallow water, repeatedly bobbing the rear of its body while picking invertebrates from water, mud, wet leaves, logs, rocks, and low vegetation. Often solitary and territorial; migration occurs mainly at night.
field_marks: Large, trim warbler with a long body and relatively short tail
Olive-brown upperparts with plain, unbarred wings
Narrow buff-to-whitish eyebrow emphasizing the dark eye
Whitish or pale buff underparts with dense dark streaking, including on the throat
Long, dusky pink legs and a narrow, dark tail
habitat: Shaded wet habitats with dense ground cover, especially wooded swamps, bogs, brush-edged ponds, lake margins, and sluggish streams. During migration it also uses small wetlands and waterside thickets; nonbreeding habitat includes mangroves and other wet forests.
